Calculé sur les mêmes critères Stockfish: Computed with the same Stockfish criteria as your games. Indicators are sorted from the largest gap to the smallest. “Within chance”: with this many games, the gap could just be luck.
Générés automatiquement à partir des par: Generated automatically from the filtered games.
Tes ouvertures coup par coup : ce que tu: Your openings move by move: what you play, what your opponents play, your score, and Stockfish's verdict on your moves (in your analysed games). Click a move to go forward.
Les positions où ton coup habituel est i: Positions where your usual move is inaccurate become a training deck: “My opening repertoire”.
Victoire = 1, nulle = ½. Toutes cadences: Win = 1, draw = ½. All time controls, other filters applied.
Score by colour in the selection.
Elo adverse moins le tien. « Comparable: Opponent's Elo minus yours. “Comparable” = within ±50 points.
Dernier Elo de chaque semaine, une courb: Last Elo of each week, one line per time control.
Après une victoire ou une défaite: After a win or a loss
Barre verte ou rouge : score nettement a: Green or red bar: score clearly above or below your overall score. Grey bar: with this many games, the gap is within chance.
L'évaluation Stockfish après 12 coups in: Stockfish's evaluation after 12 moves shows whether the opening leaves you a healthy position (in pawns, from your side).
Sous 10 parties, les résultats d'une lig: Under 10 games, a line's results swing a lot: read them as hints, not verdicts.
Pour 100 de tes coups joués dans chaque: Per 100 of your moves in each phase; the line shows your average accuracy (right scale).
Points perdus (défaite = 1, nulle = ½),: Points lost (loss = 1, draw = ½), by main cause.
Rapid contre blitz : les erreurs ne se r: Rapid vs blitz: different kinds of mistakes
Toutes les cadences analysées, autres fi: All analysed time controls, other filters applied.
Éléments détectés sur l'échiquier au mom: Elements detected on the board when you move (outside the opening). In red: clearly above your average, beyond chance. These situations are featured in “Study the position”, and king-related mistakes have their own training decks.
Tes erreurs et gaffes, avec le meilleur: Your mistakes and blunders, with Stockfish's best move. “Position” opens the Lichess analysis board on the position, before your move.
Tes propres positions critiques : trouve: Your own critical positions: find Stockfish's move. A missed position comes back in the session; a solved one comes back later and later (1, 3, 7, 16 then 35 days). Progress is saved in this browser.
Tes chances de gain selon Stockfish: Your win chances according to Stockfish
Clique sur une pièce, puis sur sa case d: Click a piece, then its destination square. Stockfish's best move is accepted, as are other moves it rates almost as good. A move outside its top 3 is not accepted, even if it may be fine: check it with the “Analysis” link. Once the exercise is done, “Why?” shows Stockfish's line and what it changes (material, pawn structure, king, pieces), the opponent's threat and the refutation of the move played in the game; “Play on” lets you continue the game against Stockfish.
Une partie jouée en club ou en tournoi :: A game played at a club or tournament: paste it as PGN, or just its moves (“1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6…”, English or French notation). Stockfish analyses it in this browser (about a minute and a half, stay on the page) and your mistakes become the “My over-the-board games” deck. Nothing is sent: the game stays in this browser and travels in the sync link.
L'analyse du navigateur est moins profon: The browser analysis is shallower than for online games: it catches clear mistakes well, inaccuracies less so. These games are not included in the stats.
Une structure de pions (pion isolé, chaî: A pawn structure (isolated pawn, chain, bind…) decides the plans of the game: grandmasters don't calculate everything, they know what to do in each structure. Click a row to open its lesson. In red: clearly more mistakes than your average, beyond chance.
Rejoue une partie de maître dans cette s: Replay a master game in this structure, move by move, in the master's shoes (“Guess the move”):
Plans rédigés pour chaque structure ; ex: Plans written for each structure; examples taken from slow games of tournaments broadcast on Lichess, between players rated 2400+.
Rejoue une partie longue d'un joueur du: Replay a long game by a top-rated Lichess player, from their side: at each move, play what you would play in their place. Stockfish compares your move with theirs. It's the best exercise for learning plans: how a strong player handles a position, move after move.
Les premiers coups (l'ouverture) se joue: The first moves (the opening) play themselves. “Your accuracy” scores each move the way Stockfish scores those of your games: a move as good as the strong player's counts just as much, even if it is different. Your progress in each game is saved: you can stop and resume.
Les positions de finale à connaître par: The endgame positions to know by heart, played against Stockfish.
Stockfish plays the other side at full strength. For a draw, hold out for the given number of moves without getting mated or letting the opponent keep a queen.
Dix de tes positions critiques à enchaîn: Ten of your critical positions to solve as fast as you can, one try each. The same series comes back until you solve it all: redoing the same positions faster and faster locks in the patterns (the “Woodpecker” method).
Une série ne change pas les dates de ret: A series doesn't change the review dates of “Find the move”. “New series” draws other positions, starting with the ones you miss most.
L'échiquier ne bouge pas : lis la suite: The board doesn't move: read the line, play it in your head, then find the best move in the final position by clicking on the starting board (the piece's starting square, then its destination). This trains calculation: seeing the position a few moves ahead. Positions from long games by strong players.
Validé : le coup de Stockfish, ou un cou: Accepted: Stockfish's move, or one it rates almost as good. A move that is illegal in the final position doesn't count: it's a sign that a piece isn't where you pictured it.
Pas de coup à trouver : évalue la positi: No move to find: evaluate the position, then spot its strengths and weaknesses, for you and for your opponent. Quiet positions (the evaluation stays stable over the next moves: no hidden tactic), taken from your games, games of stronger players and long games of top-rated players, chosen first from your weakest themes.
Les éléments sont détectés par des règle: Elements are detected by simple rules: they are pointers to build your judgement, not verdicts (an isolated pawn can also bring activity). The evaluation is Stockfish's. A solved position from your games comes back in 7 days, then later and later; a solved position from another game doesn't come back; a missed position comes back the next day.
Ta progression (positions et études) est: Your progress (positions and studies) is saved in this browser. To get it on your phone or computer, create a link here and open it on the other device: both progressions are merged.
Entre le pseudo d'un joueur : ses partie: Enter a player's username: their recent public games are analysed to find their openings, strengths and weaknesses.
Données issues de l'API publique __SITE_: Data from the public __SITE__ API. “Accuracy”: __SITE__'s when available, otherwise the Stockfish estimate (marked *).
